name: My Pet Louise
source:
Louise makes protagonist her familiar and treats him like a commoner. If he is obedient enough, there is a reward awaiting.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
露易丝让主角变得很熟悉，并像对待平民一样对待他。如果他足够听话，就有奖励在等着他。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
